title: PRISM Command Frontmatter Schema (COMMAND-KERNEL-MS0 / U-CK06)
description: Canonical YAML frontmatter for skills under .claude/commands/*.md. Underpins the psk syscall layer + composition primitive. Backward-compat: anything beyond the 6 core fields is optional; existing skills with only `name` + `description` validate against this schema today, then get progressively enriched by the U-CK08 corpus migration.

name.description: Skill slug — kebab-case, optional one-level namespace (e.g. `sparc:ask`). Lowercase, hyphenated. Becomes the slash-command name (/<name>).

description.description: Single-paragraph hook surfaced in the auto-suggest list. Should state WHAT the skill does in 1-3 sentences plus when to use it.

version.description: Semver. Bump major on incompatible argument changes, minor on additive behaviour, patch on bug fixes / doc tweaks.

tier.description: Hook-tier alignment. T0 = critical (blocks Stop on failure), T1 = high-priority (advisory), T2 = inject (UserPromptSubmit additionalContext), T3 = nudge, T4 = telemetry / advisory only, T5 = experimental. Used by the auto-trigger orchestrator to budget execution.

keywords.description: Substrings matched against the user prompt by `skill-auto-trigger.mjs`. Top-K (default 3) skills are surfaced as suggestions.

regex.description: Optional regex pattern. When provided, used INSTEAD of keywords (one or the other).

minScore.description: Minimum BM25 score required to surface (0..1). Default 0.3.

events.description: Hook events that may auto-invoke this skill (advisory; the harness wiring is separate).

consumes.description: Inputs this skill reads from: file paths, dispatcher actions (e.g. `prism_dev:build_state_summary`), other skills, or environment variables. Used by the dependency-graph generator to surface upstream changes that invalidate cached outputs.

produces.description: Outputs this skill writes: file paths, dispatcher actions emitted, persistent state files. Used by downstream skills to declare `consumes`.

composes_with.description: Other slash-commands this skill orchestrates internally (e.g. /checkin composes_with: ['/handoff','/precompact']). Used by U-CK25 /pipeline meta-command for static dependency analysis.

pipeline.description: Pipeline name (e.g. forge, forge-audit, rgs, roadmap, close-out, session-cycle).

phase.description: Phase identifier within that pipeline (e.g. preflight, surface-enum, verify, emit).

ordering.description: Where in the phase this skill fires. Default: during.

pipeline_integrations.description: Registers this skill as a participant in named pipelines. Read by U-CK14 (activate pipeline_integrations) + U-CK16 (skill-auto-trigger pipeline-aware).

model.description: Preferred Claude tier. `auto` defers to model-router. Default: inherit from caller (no override).

effort.description: Reasoning depth hint to the harness. Default: inherit.

allowed-tools.description: Tools this skill needs (e.g. ['Read','Edit','Bash']). Empty = inherits from session policy.

context.description: Context-budget hint. `minimal` = short skill, no exploration; `max` = research-heavy. Default: normal.

owner.description: Slot or chat that owns the skill (e.g. 'alpha', 'golf', 'pp-team'). Used for routing + ownership audits.

replacement.description: Slug of the replacement skill, if any

deprecated.description: Mark the skill deprecated. Picked up by skill-lint.
